reviews.text: 拯救在线游戏的最好方法，就是在1.0版本半价后打个七折，作为EA玩家的补偿，会有一个皮肤表情的支持者包，大概EPIC玩家和在微软购买的玩家，应该和我看到恶意不息长期七折，顺便送我一个支持者包时，一样的感想吧，这年头，独立游戏组真的不可信 去年在XGP玩过一段时间，作为俯视角动作游戏，刷刷刷还是挺带感的，Thunder Lotus作为独立游戏界的十年老组，游戏的基础底子还是很硬实的，demo如果打了一局觉得挺不错，那快乐的刷一百个小时，起码是不成问题的，但想刷两百个小时还不觉得枯燥，那就有些过于幻想了，毕竟现在只是四十块的游戏，这种降价也是官方对于游戏内容量的一种暗示 除此之外1.0终于加入了中文，不过不知为何依旧是把我自动扔到了欧服，亚服也不知服务器在哪，依旧是比美服高两倍的延迟，不过我猜大概率是韩国，就像暗黑4一样？ 总之，喝杯水上个厕所，刷起来肝起来，趁着人最多的时候，冲冲冲！

别无脑入了，看什么好评，差评才是该看的，等你玩到第二张图就知道差评什么意思了，一图BOSS脚打都能过，二图人少数值高开始狠狠坐牢，而三图只能进11人野队你就玩吧，如果你只打第一张图就当我没说，以下内容与你无关，一个月之后这游戏内必不见你影子，所以开心就好。【顺便一提截至26年6月14号，通过第二图拿到成就的人才12%】 正式版遗物改的很烂，爆炸/小球/增益球，增伤方面约等于无，回血回能还算有点用处不过飞升之战看的可不是你能活多久，飞升之战是有时限的，输出低最后会被烫死，这就涉及到第二张图的难度，敌方数值太高而且只能进22人，其中有刚打完第一张图就直接来的没有心理准备的新手，有半生不熟以为自己行了结果中途去碰瓷BOSS房被踹飞的自信哥，剩下的就是发挥稳定又不稳定的高手和老手，运气好飞升能剩下个十人左右，运气差就刚开的那把最后剩4个人，更有意思的是，职业强度稀烂，如果你选的是拿杖的那两个，恭喜你甚至在一图都打不出伤害纯刮痧还容易死，妥妥的负担。这游戏想法是好的，鼓励你合作一块走，但是避免不了局内玩家越死越少，不能指望每个玩家都玩的透彻，于是到最后只会发展成一看你装饰是朴素的，就默认你是新手，然后把你嫌弃了，俩月之后整个服务器都只剩骑士牢玩家以及唐到极致的伪人，这游戏就凉了。 忘了补充几个很烦人的点，里边小怪恶心人的有好几种，点名第一张图是那个会冲刺过来突然突进给你一刀的刀哥，没事就钻地撞你钻了之后再钻然后吐吐吐的虫子，第二张图是会给怪回血的一个绿帽罐，三合一的眼珠子一次会扔三球，这些怪单打都有些恶心，和其他怪配合起来更是无敌，比如占点任务+刀哥，钻地虫配地火之类的，简直是享受。 武器系统，想自定义武器需要做几阶的任务，最要命的是你需要解锁自定义之后，再用这把武器进去打，才有概率掉落武器特性石头，这个概率就很神奇，一把应该最多就一个，有时候好几把不会出，6个配件你可能要刷上个10把以上，体感同一武器解锁越多反而掉率越低，就像是仓库检测让人恼火。 场外可以带的角色特性有用的也没几个，前中期基本就是三个槽位，白骨加成（局内货币涉及遗物重选和升级以及买血买道具）+灵尘加成（局内经验值用来升级提属性）+随意（比如伤害抗性/遗物掉率/血量上限这种），有些特性一看就是拉中之拉，当然在地球上的一些地方，拉=神。 还有一些致命BUG，因为拿了某些遗物比如爆炸发球这种会导致你的轻击或重击不会计入合作打击，也就是硬少了将近100%的额外增伤，非常要命。

33 Immortals is this [i] weird [/i] combination of mechanics - that being MMO-style, large group co-operation, Hades-esque gameplay, and Genuinely Putting Trust in a player named IamScaredofWomen99 you met two minutes ago to keep you alive - that rightly shouldn't work, but seems to pull it off somehow. Having been part of the alphas/playtests, I've seen a fair bit of this game's development, all the way up to the complete revamp of relics on steam launch - it's solid. It's literally Bozja Southern Front(tm) from Final Fantasy XIV(tm) with a whole Dante's Inferno coat of paint. If reading that caused you to lean forward a little, then yeah, it's probably exactly your kind of game to boot up after a productive two hours running around a player hub doing exactly nothing in your favourite MMO. Now, speaking [i] completely [/i] objectively here, I need you to look at me. I need you to read the next sentence carefully. I need to you understand that the idea of making a game that requires [i] thirty three [/i] crackheads to participate in The Great Biblical Jumping as Forseen By Big G Themselves is NOT a feasible, long term premise. That's half the reason the game's price point is what it is - the design, the premise, the moment to moment gameplay? Raw sauce. The concept that this game's gonna get thirty two other goobers to join you in the first area in like, two months? Delusional take. It's a great game, an amazing concept, and that unfortunately comes with the very real downside of being one co-op roguelike in a very, very expansive market. You'll read a lot of reviews that state it 'scratches an itch' for a lot of people, and that's honestly a very apt description; it's sort of like an MMO raid start-to-finish, except you're all in one-man parties (or an ACTUAL party of four, though I've only ever been in one in my gametime sofar and it changed basically nothing) desperately trying to co-operate. If you die twice in a row? The server moderator kills you in real life, removing you from the server. What ends up happening is this weird little simulation of darwhinism each run, where the most feral, talented, or just downright lucky raid members survive until the end to throw down with the final boss. The bosses themselves have great designs, are pretty easy to sight-read, and shouldn't be anything too insane to anyone who's played an MMO, but I should also preface this by looping this riiiiight back to the sentence before I asked you to pay attention to. While you CAN have an utterly insane build cooking and you CAN carry people, the entire premise of 33 immortals is that you're a rogue army. Army being the operative word here. These bosses WILL eventually start throwing out undodgeable, unblockable mechanics at you if your team just can't dish out enough damage, or have enough people to do their mechanics. I've had runs basically end the moment we step into the boss arena because the six whole people who made it have made eyecontact with each other and collectively agreed to give up and not waste fifteen minutes in a bossfight we just can't clear. All of that to say; you either all make it, or none of you do. And you can only do so much to keep people in the game. 33 Immortals does a lot of cool stuff - it's comfort food for people who like Hades and MMO-style games, and will definitely have a lot of players hooked with its long-term metaprogression. It's a fun, face-paced raid-like. The Sword of Damocles that is its whole 33-people lobbies is also just there in the corner. Don't think about it too hard and enjoy throwing hands with God.

弱智一样的披着共斗外皮的局外抖m刷子游戏 纯粹的浪费时间 野排天堂10把过不了1把 11人匹配进头目战7个人 实则2人牵5狗 还没办法讲机制，哦只能你打完第一把才能在说明里看机制——那么问题来了，下一把匹配你就能确保队友不是第一次进天堂？下一把还是有一半的路人不知道；然而知道了又怎么样，输出高的老玩家被低输出拖累，他们开着12磨难没办法重生，一次处理不当神之怒就会全屏三次aoe，直接带走残血和无法复活的高输出玩家，最多两次就撑不住了，你知不知道你这三个图的难度曲线是指数增加的？你个沙雕你测试过吗？不到用户活跃期连匹配都凑不齐人，而抖m老玩家早都抱团组队彻底刷干了游戏，没剩几个继续玩的，因为你地图没深意对局重复度过高遗物还不多，你连黑环的1/50遗物都没有，滚出共斗游戏，滚出肉鸽游戏，滚出合作游戏，滚出局外成长游戏，集糟粕于大成者，恶心至极！ This is a masochistic grinder game draped in the thin guise of cooperative play—an utter waste of time, nothing short of idiotic. In public lobbies, you're lucky to clear even one out of ten runs. The "11-player" boss fight often starts with only 7, yet in reality it's two players dragging five deadweights along, with no way to explain mechanics mid-match. Oh, you can only read the strategy after your first attempt—so tell me, does that guarantee your next lobby won't be full of first-timers? Of course not; half the randoms will still be clueless. But even if they knew, what then? High-damage veterans get dragged down by low-output teammates, stuck in a 12-difficulty run with no resurrection—one misstep triggers God's Wrath, a full-screen triple AOE that wipes out weakened players and permanently kills your top DPS. Two rounds of that and it's over. Do you even realize your difficulty curve scales exponentially across these three maps? Did you even test this garbage? Outside peak hours, you can't even fill a lobby, while the masochistic veterans have long since formed premade squads, milked the game dry, and moved on—barely anyone's left. Why? Because your maps lack depth, your runs are painfully repetitive, and your relic pool is pitiful—not even 1/50 of what Black Ring offers. Get out of the co-op genre. Get out of the roguelike space. Get out of the team-based and progression-based design. You've managed to cram every worst practice into one package—disgusting to the core. 共闘の皮を被った、ドM向けのただの周回ゲー——頭がおかしいレベルで、純粋に時間の無駄だ。野良マッチングでは10回やって1回もクリアできない。11人用のボス戦にマッチするのはせいぜい7人、実態は2人が5匹の犬を引きずってるようなものだ。しかも戦略を伝える手段すらない。ああ、最初の1回を終えた後にしか説明文を読めないのか——ならば聞くが、次のマッチで相方が初見じゃないと保証できるのか？次も半分は無知な野良だろう。だが、知ってたところでどうなる？火力の高い古参は低火力の足を引っ張られ、12の苦難で蘇生もできず、一度ミスすれば神の怒りが全体3連続AOE、瀕死の者や復活不可の高火力勢は即座にやられる。2度耐えれば限界だ。この3マップの難易度曲線が指数関数的だって自覚あるのか？テスターはやったのか？オフピーク時にはマッチングすらままならない。一方でドMの古参はとっくに固定パーティを組み、ゲームを絞り尽くして去り、残った者はほぼいない。なぜならマップに深みがなく、周回の単調さは異常で、レリックも少なすぎる——『ブラックリング』の50分の1すらない。共闘ゲームから消えろ。ローグライクから消えろ。協力ゲームから消えろ。局外成長ゲームから消えろ。悪しき要素をこれでもかと集めた大傑作、吐き気がするほどに。 공투라는 가죽을 뒤집은, 그냥 피지컬 MZ 노가다 게임——멍청하기 짝이 없고 순수하게 시간 낭비입니다. 야매 매칭으로는 10판 중 1판도 클리어 못 해요. 11인용 보스전에 매칭되면 겨우 7명, 실상은 2명이 5마리 강아지를 끌고 다니는 꼴인데, 메커니즘을 알려줄 수단도 없어요. 아, 첫 판을 끝내야 설명을 볼 수 있다고요——그럼 다음 판에 매칭된 팀원이 처음 들어온 사람이 아닐 거란 보장이 있나요? 다음 판에도 절반은 모르는 초보일 겁니다. 하지만 안다고 해서 뭐가 달라지나요? 딜 높은 고인물은 저딜에 끌려다니면서, 12고난에서는 부활도 안 되는데, 실수 한 번에 신의 분노가 전범위 3연속 광역기로 터져서, 피 적은 캐릭터와 부활 불가능한 고딜러는 그냥 쓰러져요. 두 번 버티면 끝입니다. 이 세 맵의 난이도 곡선이 지수함수라는 걸 알고나 있는 겁니까? 테스트는 해본 겁니까? 피크 타임 아니면 매칭조차 안 될 텐데, 그 사이에 MZ 고인물들은 이미 고정팟 짜서 게임을 완전히 짜내고 떠나고, 남은 사람은 거의 없어요. 맵은 깊이 없고, 반복 플레이는 지루하기 그지없고, 유물은 너무 부족해서——'블랙 링'의 50분의 1도 안 돼요. 공투 게임에서 꺼져. 로그라이크에서 꺼져. 협력 게임에서 꺼져. 외부 성장 게임에서 꺼져. 온갖 폐단을 한데 모은 걸작, 정말 역겹군요.

Amazing game! Reminds me of my old days playing WoW raids as a Hunter. It’s like Hades + Diablo world bosses + WoW raids. Strong execution of a really clever multiplayer roguelike idea. 8 classes. Lots of unique enemies. One big boss. Not sure how well it’ll hold up in the long run, but right now I’m having a blast with the gameplay loop. The game definitely needs more content in the future to stay alive longer. I also strongly recommend jump in now while the game is still populated. This feels like a very specific kind of multiplayer magic that won’t hit the same once the playerbase fades away, so don’t miss it. And one QoL request for the devs: please add an option to block or avoid players after matches. Some people are using really offensive nicknames.

实在是太无聊了，作为肉鸽局内局外都是一坨，局外成长简陋到看不了，就是拿货币升级很有限的几个遗物，遗物效果也只是给伤害数字加0，没有改变玩法的遗物，武器拿到的一瞬间已经定性了，像弓基本就是射箭+回收箭+大招，升到5级也不过是双箭+穿透箭+攻速+自动回收，和遗物没任何联动。其他几把武器也是一样的，哪怕你做出点不一样的呢？刚拿到就是射箭回收，升满级就是更轻松的射箭，这都啥年代了，换成传奇都比你这个玩法多吧？ 任务更是烂磨，绑定升级就算了，还难做的一批，基本都是拿时间来换。（这游戏有点像supercell的手游mo.co，但是moco的成长已经很烂了，但是让我二选一我选mo.co） 手感也很烂，闪避不能打断动作，人物总感觉很粘滞（我单人开房间测了，不是网络问题），前摇后摇都很长，玩起来是一点也不快乐。 唯一值得夸的就是美术风格了。

我在xbox已经玩了1000多个小时了，从游戏的game preview阶段开始就一直在玩，制作组从game preview版本就一直积极更新，修改和完善各种内容和bug，相信在这次正式版本推出之后也会收集玩家的意见进行游戏的更新和修改的。 游戏是没有国区服务器的，和许多需要联机的外服的游戏一样，开加速器游玩会更好一些。 我开加速器玩5-6个小时都不会掉线或者卡顿，无论是从steam登录还是epic登录，游玩都很稳定。 如果因为掉线和卡顿问题而导致游戏体验不好，可以考虑一下更换一下加速器或者选择更好的网络。 游戏支持跨平台联机，无论是从steam 、epic还是xbox主机及xbox pc端登录的玩家，大家不仅可以一起在对局里一起游玩，还可以通过组队码进行跨平台组队，一起匹配进游戏。 游戏正式版本更新之后，一共有8种武器，每种武器都有6个升级技能，游戏的内容还是很耐玩的。全部内容玩完之后还有高难挑战（自选defuff的磨难系统），相当于给喜欢挑战的玩家增加了难度，同时也增加了奖励，属于12难的特殊饰品，并且在6难的时候会出现祝福遗物（效果更强），9难的时候会在局内掉落武器的升级，理论上可以拿到一把武器的完全体（同时携带带6个武器升级），让武器更强。 建议新玩家不要速推游戏，不要抢地牢，可以多farm一下，把各个状态升起来之后再去打boss，并且尽量找到秘密地牢。速推游戏让进入boss的每个玩家都不强，在后面的地图里就很难战胜boss。 另外关于磨难系统，可以等熟悉游戏之后再挑战12难，如果刚玩不久就打高难（12难），那么体验肯定不会太好，自己赢不了不说，还会拖累整个房间里的其他的玩家的输出。毕竟这是一个合作类的多人联机游戏。 游戏的难度是根据进入boss战的玩家人数进行动态调整的，虽然说最多支持33个人一起游玩（图1），但是如果只有几个人一起玩，比如3个人一起进入到boss战，那么游戏的难度就会按照3玩家的难度进行调整，boss的难度就会下调，完全不会存在人数少打不过的情况。 并且游戏可以设置私人房间，如果只是几个朋友想一起玩，不想去和随机的玩家一起，那么是可以开启私人房间的，再加上游戏难度根据人数匹配，也可以获得很好的游戏体验。

DEMO50小时，本体20小时，14功绩。这并不是老手，大概肝了游戏的三分之一内容。 直接省流版：游戏没内容（就三张图三个BOSS），肝度爆炸（150小时起步重复刷三张图），游戏制作组傻逼（听不懂中国玩家游戏建议），野排环境恶劣（野人不看机制，有时候会导致灭团，当然，这个游戏的地下城手册也烂，见到BOSS那个技能你才能解锁图鉴，导致很多人根本不知道BOSS机制。） 本来我其实还想继续肝的，因为这款游戏挺有意思的，但今天我彻底没心气了，那是一种从下午两点刷到晚上七点不出一个模组的痛，是天堂FARM四十分钟八个人进BOSS结果被神怒一脚踢死的痛，一阶段我还忙着推球呢，一扭头野人全死了，就剩我和朋友两个人，而且这样的场景根本不少见。 那么回到正题，为什么我要给差评：首先是肝度，这个就是最大的问题，每一把武器都要肝，他的武器任务是分层的，比如第一层你需要做三个任务，第二层五个这样的，一共有很多层，但每一层的任务不继承，这就意味着：要么你在一局内打满三个任务，要么你就开两局。然后反复折叠。这是其一。 其二是每把武器都有六个独立的武器模块，在没有模块之前基本体验都是吃屎级别，这个模块的开启方式是做武器系列任务，然后再在局内掉落，并且完全随机，并且每一局你只能掉落一个，一把武器六个模块，有八把武器，这就是四十八把游戏。（当然看到这里会有人说：每日任务是送模块的，确实，现实时间三天，还要每天登陆做完每日任务才能送，他真无敌了。）另外再说一句，这个模块是随机掉落的，我弩模块5/6，最后一个模块刷了三把炼狱三把地狱（现实时间大约三到四小时）仍然没出，很难不怀疑是制作组的小巧思，想让你用每日开出来。PS：武器模块有一个专精系统，就是你带着这个模块进本打伤害，大概两把的时间你能做满，做满专精的效果是全武器增加1%伤害，48个模块就是48%，不知道你愿不愿意为了这个专精系统去肝呢？ 那么接下来就是改动：改动方面我打了很多字，但还是删除了，因为我不知道怎么评价。在游戏群里我们说跟运营反馈一下，运营：STEAM差评冲锋没啥用，因为外国制作组看不懂中文，不如DC冲锋。其实群里运营人挺好的，但是在这种傻鸟制作组改动之下，变成了纯两面受气，反馈外国制作组不想吊，回来还得挨玩家骂。我不想评价任何改动，我只会直接攻击。 经过了刚才打了一大段改动的评价之后，我已经没有心力再写多余的东西了。总而言之，这个游戏的内容，就是三个BOSS，三张地图，八把武器玩法，其他的全都是附加。但所有的游戏功能都需要解锁，有一种你购买了蒙娜丽莎的头，但你需要解锁他的左脚左手右脚右手，拼成黑暗大法师，然后被没游戏理解的老外质疑开挂的美。游戏内容没多少，全靠肝度累计，我能玩这么久全靠有朋友在一起玩。就这样吧，累了。

What I want from in-run upgrades isn't something like "chance to spawn healing orbs / co-op point orbs / fire missiles." What I want is a different experience after each mini-dungeon or ascension run—like making the six weapon runes drop from chests. People who want to grind get a better experience, and those who don't won't be left too far behind. It's a simple truth: a run takes 20–30 minutes. The first unlock for each weapon is something useless like an automatic co-op bar fill, meaning every player has to play at least an hour before they can actually start enjoying the roguelike fun. And to try two rune combos, you have to grind even more. That's just absurd. You say the raid mode needs people to keep grinding to sustain the cycle, and there are plenty of ways to do that—but making the roguelike fun itself the reason to grind is not the way. New players will look into it and stop coming. Light grinders (like me—I spent 15 hours grinding the bow to level 5) really don't want to grind another hour just to unlock rune slots for other weapons, so I just quit. Hardcore grinders will naturally drop off too when they can't find matches. And on top of that, another player mentioned that to get passive growth you have to enable higher restrictions, but higher restrictions make your character weaker, so the more you grind, the weaker you get—it's discouraging in every way. Only if they adjust this grind point does the game have a chance to survive. After all, the marketing has been decent, and there are still enough players right now. But if they don't change it, it'll become a dead game soon, and once it hits the threshold where you can't fill lobbies, it's game over.

I had a good time playing [i]33 Immortals[/i]. I think the game does a lot of things well: [list] [*]It looks nice. The art style is beautiful. [*]It feels nice. It just plays well. [*]The co-op mechanics are interesting. I like co-op powers, co-strikes, and boss-related mechanics that make you rely on other players. [*]All the existing weapons are unique. [*]Boss fights are interesting. [/list] However, a lot of things could be improved: [list] [*]The Relic system is boring. There's no variety—more than half of the relics are straight-up useless. [*]Most of the weapon upgrades are bad. There's usually only one viable build, and the others only make your weapon worse. The Sword is especially guilty of this—its upgrades are terrible. [*]Most of the content is a DPS check. Having more than a few support weapons in the lobby puts you at a disadvantage. More than two Sword users in a public Paradiso lobby can make it unbeatable—they'll likely be the only survivors, with zero impact on the final fight. [*]Because of all this, there's little to no replayability. Every run feels the same—you're locked into using the same weapon, with the same upgrades and the same relics. [*]Boss mechanics aren't explained well—especially for the last boss. You essentially have to fail a few times to unlock Compendium entries and learn how to beat it, and it's not intuitive. [*]The progression is very grindy, especially for the weapons. They're stripped of all their functionality at the start—you can't level up co-op power, you can't get upgrades. You have to do 4–6 runs just to unlock that feature, then you have to do even more runs to actually get weapon upgrades as loot. And then, to progress the feats, you have to do hundreds of runs: complete 30 secret rooms, beat 40 unique elites, complete 50 ascensions. The icing on the cake is the "Weapon Mastery III" feats—you have to beat every boss 5 times with every weapon. That's 120 successful runs, and each run is what, 30–60 minutes long? [*]Cosmetics... I don't even know. Why do you need every emote to be in four different rarities? It's just bloat—an illusion of content. The same goes for other items; they're basically recolors. Only the halos are somewhat unique in my opinion. [/list] I'm not opposed to grind—I like it. But the amount of grind this game has is not justified by the amount of replayability it provides. Another point of concern is bugs. I mean, having bugs in software is natural, but they need to be addressed. When whole subsystems, like weapon mastery, are straight-up completely not working, and it hasn't been addressed for more than two weeks after release, that's concerning. A cooperative game with 33 players is a very ambitious goal, which is why I'm worried about the game's future. There's no roadmap. There's not even a post about when we can expect bug fixes. There's complete radio silence. And maybe this game is not meant to last. Maybe it's a one-and-done deal and not a live-service game. But I would love it to have a long shelf life.

I wanted to wait an entire month before writing the review, but considering it doesn't appear that things will get better, I decided to do it now. The game and premise is cool, but it is fundamentally lacking in a lot of areas that are somewhat surprising to me, as some mechanics are staples in the genres that this game takes from. Reasons why I wouldn't recommend this game to others even if I have played a bunch since release: - The gameplay loop gets tedious fast - you get fasttracked to all the worlds relatively fast by being carried by others when you still don't know a lot of the mechanics, which at the last world gets really punishing in random lobbies as you get players that do not know the mechanics. Worse still is that they are not intuitive and you have to encounter them first before reading about them. This means you could sabotage 3-4 runs for other people just because the information is hidden and you might not encounter all attacks in every run. - Feats are boring and force you to play in a specific way, which is even more boring. You have 8 different weapons and they have their own questlines for overall progression, but they are so copy pasted from one another that it is really boring. No flavor for the specific weapon, just kill x bosses or elites with this shooter weapon, kill the same amount for the specialist weapon, kill the same amount for the tank weapon. The difference in quests making the weapons feel unique is laughable. - The upgrade system is also not thought out well. You have 6 upgrades per weapon, you can only unlock 1 new one once per run. Even if you run ordeals that allow you to circumvent the cap of 2 upgrades per run, that doesn't allow you to also be rewarded with fast unlocks, by making the game harder for yourself. Additionally, you don't even get progression on the specific upgrades when you play with them like this, meaning you are again forced to play in a specific way to attain the weapon mastery. This means 2-3 games with a specific upgrade. Considering some upgrades are straight up trash, it can be annoying wanting to gain the mastery (which is supposed to give you 1% damage increase per mastery), but having to sacrifice several runs to play in an unfun way. - Ordeals - this system is very badly designed. You are unlocking progression only to then equip an ordeal that just removes this progression for instance. It is very unimaginative and this game could learn from games like Hades where the way to make the game harder for yourself was done in a way where it changes the gameplay, via more difficult versions of bosses, more difficult versions of specific minions, etc. Especially when you have the questlines for a bunch of things tied to ordeals, it is again a boring way to enforce the gameplay loop and replay worlds. Bugs - there are so many bugs that there has been no sign of them being fixed. Random crashes, people being thrown out of parties randomly (this is especially annoying when you have a questline to be in a party, you start a run and you get thrown out of the party, so you can't even do your progression), visual bugs, spaghetti coded mechanics that make no sense. 1 month almost after release, none of these have been addressed. The feeling of having invested 30-40 minutes to play a specific way because of the feats, only to have the game crash at the boss and not saving what you have achieved during the run makes you want to just stop playing for a while. The weapon masteries that are 48 in total are supposed to give you 1% damage increase for every one, it doesn't work. Blast relics screw up one of the core functionalities in co-strike that increases your damage if you attack the same target. There are a bunch more. - Relics - incredibly boring mechanics with half the relics not even being worthwhile to pick. Blast is bugged and is absolutely useless on ranged weapons as the blast comes from your model instead of where you attack, missiles are trash, healing is not often needed, especially on lower ordeals. At the same time you are again forced by a questline to unlock every single relic in the game, which makes it annoying that you have to pick useless relics, just for the chance to unlock a specific duo or boost relic for the progression. - UI and QOL - I don't mean to sound all-knowing but I can't believe someone saw how things are set up and said "this is great, players will enjoy this". The relic menu is atrocious and is done in such a cumbersome way that it boggles the mind that someone thought this works. Having to run over bones or shards to pick them up is stupid, when you have 30ish other people doing the same, as visual clarity becomes a problem, they could have just floated to you. Considering how grindy the feats system is, it is really annoying that they don't track progression proactively. I can unlock 9 ordeals and play on those before reaching the mastery quest for a weapon and still defeat the boss, but when I unlock the quest, the progression will start from 0. Instead of feeling like you get rewarded for how you played the game or your skill, you just feel forced to play the same way over and over again. The game design in a lot of aspects is just straight up bad. You don't have loadouts for perks if you want to have a damage or a support build, you have to change your perks every time you decide to switch a weapon, which is a lot considering how the questlines make you do every single weapon. Overall cool premise, graphics are fun, but the game design is horrendous and the game is just not sustainable long term like this. Game-breaking bugs from the start that are not fixed for a month. I have played games that were in early access that were more polished than this on its actual release. The game could have been great, but it feels like it was made by people that have no idea about games or what gamers find fun.

I play from South America on US servers with around 170ms, and honestly, that's not even the biggest issue. The real problem is the constant desync. Almost every run I get rubberbanding, freezes, random disconnects, or my character just gets completely out of sync with the server. I've literally spent minutes watching my character run into a wall until I die, and then everything suddenly works again. It's a shame because I actually enjoy the game, but right now the online experience is so bad that I just can't recommend it.
